title: Chunk Cache
description: Ever wanted to download a part of a server but don't have access to the world file? This mod does that
body:
This mod caches chunks when they're sent from the server to your client. It's completely client side and lets you download the world from just playing in it.

![GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9feda87a0b94602590da28ca5c4cbb33b88a54e0_0.webp)

Features:
- Press F9 to open GUI menu
- Toggleable in menu
- Automatically clears cache when switching servers
- Map to see what's been cached
- Saves to a single player world with name selected
